name: plugin.rea_managed_runtime
description: REA managed runtime & bytecode forensics: .NET PE/CLI headers, Unity IL2CPP global-metadata.dat, zero-allocation GGUF/safetensors inspection, and CPython bytecode disassembly.

entrypoints.name: rea_inspect_managed_artifact
entrypoints.description: Inspect an explicit Windows PE/CLI or .NET DLL without loading it as a live assembly.

entrypoints.name: rea_inspect_managed_native_boundaries
entrypoints.description: Inspect PE/CLI ModuleRef, ImplMap, and P/Invoke declarations.

parameters.name: max_records
parameters.description: Maximum records to extract per section

entrypoints.name: rea_inspect_model_artifact
entrypoints.description: Inspect local GGUF v2/v3 or safetensors headers using direct byte seeks.

parameters.name: preview_tensors
parameters.description: Maximum tensor descriptors to return in header summary

entrypoints.name: rea_inspect_python_pyc
entrypoints.description: Inspect local CPython 3.7-3.13 .pyc bytecode files and disassemble opcodes.

parameters.name: disassemble
parameters.description: Whether to disassemble code object opcodes
